m1 - d_ent half RULED YES by the chief, and BLOCKED on a reservation. Not started.

WHY IT CANNOT BE SPLIT: the change is atomic across two files. cost.scala:722 must return Estimate.missing(AllMissing), and wire.scala:188 must admit Entity to MayBeMissing. Landing only cost.scala makes wire.scala:298 (missingTerms.subsetOf(MayBeMissing)) REJECT every record carrying the new missing term.

wire.scala is held by codex-storymodel-new-engineer under rv-01M1758P1JHQQ6ZWFTRWAGQ4WJ for slice E. I have asked for a ping when it frees (msg-01M176YXM7CD75PRXZ60ARWWH5); no urgency, the defect is latent on the current corpus.

I did NOT reserve cost.scala. Holding one half while blocked on the other is the orphaned-reservation pattern, and it would block others for no benefit to me.

I did NOT ask the engineer to add the one-line MayBeMissing entry inside their slice. It belongs with the cost.scala change and its golden re-cut; splitting it would put a line in their candidate that nothing in their candidate explains.

CHIEF'S REQUIREMENTS, recorded so they survive the wait:
  1. empty  yields Estimate.missing(AllMissing), recorded in missingTerms
  2. DO NOT change the formula for the non-empty case - record absence, do not retune, because moving both at once confounds two reasons for a number changing
  3. measure the movement and record under ADR 0003, as for d_sens
  4. carry the fixture-accident caveat into the commit body: 0.5 was ambiguous IN PRINCIPLE before it was ambiguous in practice, because measured dEnt is 1.0 - credit/n and two participants at half credit each give exactly 0.500

Scope: cost.scala:722 plus the wire admission, matching ee258bf's shape. Semantic stays correctly excluded - dense, imputed, not absent.
